title.narrative: UNICEF Child Protection programme continued to expand during 2024 with 29 partners providing child protection, gender-based violence, and youth and adolescents interventions across all 10 states and three administrative areas, significantly increasing coverage. UNICEF child protection partners provided services to 494,488 people (163,359 boys, 170,335 girls, 119,697 women and 41,097 men), achieving; more than double of the of planned coverage 215,000 people.
